fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-06-17 at about 21:55, it was reported that residents near Nila Puram Main Street reported repeated visits by a group of persons allegedly exchanging small packets, raising suspicion of the sale of a banned substance. Contact details given by the complainant, Sangeetha Sri, include the number 9000000007. Abirami Raj (mobile 9000000141) was named as a possible person of interest. A witness, Anitha Raman, reachable on 9000000267, was mentioned in the complaint. A car bearing the number TN-39-ZZ-1044 was seen leaving the area. A further person, Dinesh Subramani, a co-worker, using the number 9000000212, is stated to be associated with the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Residents reportedly noticed regular late-night visits at the same spot.
fields.Keywords: suspected narcotics, suspicious activity, main street, suspect, witness statement, witness, night, car
